en: I swear by this city [i.e., Makkah]
And you, [O Muḥammad], are free of restriction in this city
And [by] the father and that which was born [of him],
We have certainly created man into hardship.

ar: أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ أَحَدٌ
tr: Ayahsabu an lan yaqdira AAalayhi ahadun
en: Does he think that never will anyone overcome him?
He says, "I have spent wealth in abundance."
Does he think that no one has seen him?
Have We not made for him two eyes?
And a tongue and two lips?
And have shown him the two ways?
But he has not broken through the difficult pass.
And what can make you know what is [breaking through] the difficult pass?
It is the freeing of a slave

ar: أَوْ إِطْعَـٰمٌ فِى يَوْمٍ ذِى مَسْغَبَةٍ
tr: Aw itAAamun fee yawmin thee masghabatin
en: Or feeding on a day of severe hunger
An orphan of near relationship
Or a needy person in misery

ar: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْمَرْحَمَةِ
tr: Thumma kana mina allatheena amanoo watawasaw bialssabri watawasaw bialmarhamati
en: And then being among those who believed and advised one another to patience and advised one another to compassion.
Those are the companions of the right.

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
tr: Waallatheena kafaroo biayatina hum ashabu almashamati
en: But they who disbelieved in Our signs - those are the companions of the left.
Over them will be fire closed in.
